list: the official 55 trophies, as published on PlayStation

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list
sources.what: the official names, descriptions, grades and hidden flags

sources.name: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies
sources.what: the counts PlayStation tracks for the counted trophies

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum: it lands the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing to hunt for directly. Work the roadmap stages in order, keep the missables page beside you during the campaign, and let this be the last trophy that pops.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story. Complete Gone Fishing, the opening mission the description names. It is the first thing the game asks of you, so it cannot be missed: finish the prologue and the trophy is yours.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story. Complete Chapter 1. Chapter trophies are awarded for finishing the chapter, so steady story progress is the whole guide: play the campaign and this arrives on its own.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story. Complete Chapter 2. The name is PlayStation's own censorship, asterisks and all; the requirement is plain: finish the chapter and the trophy pops as the next one opens.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story. Complete Chapter 3. Halfway through the campaign's chapter run; nothing to prepare and nothing to miss, just keep the story moving.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story. Complete Chapter 4, the last of the numbered chapters. After this only the final mission stands between you and the story gold, so sweep the missables page before pushing on.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story, gold. Complete the final mission. The campaign's last stretch, and the gold is automatic once it is done. Before you start the finale, close out the stranger strands and the flagged one-off beats on the missables page: the campaign is the one part of the game that does not wait for you.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story. Complete the mission Breakfast Run, named in the description. Story missions are played in the campaign's order, so this pops when the story reaches it; no detour is possible or needed.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story. Complete The Cartel Heist. A named story mission, played as the campaign unfolds; finish the job and the trophy follows the mission complete screen.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story. Complete the mission Child's Play. Like the other named-mission trophies it is a waypoint of the campaign: reach the mission, finish it, move on.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story. Complete the mission Headliners. The stylised trophy name is PlayStation's; the task is a straight campaign mission, earned in story order.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story. Complete VCIA Takedown, the campaign's airport mission. Remember the place: VCIA is also where Catch Me If You Can hides its unscheduled departure, so keep that flag in mind while the story has you there.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story. Complete Operation Savage Glory. A named late-campaign mission; it arrives in story order and the trophy follows its completion.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Gold. Attain 100% completion. Almost everything else on this list feeds the game's completion percentage — story, strands, collectibles, activities — so treat this as the sum of the roadmap rather than a task of its own. When it is the last thing standing, the in-game completion screen names the category that is short; finish that, and the gold lands, followed by the platinum.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — the count PlayStation tracks. Stunt jumps and set-piece leaps are scattered across Leonida, and the description asks for volume, not perfection, so bank them as you travel instead of grinding at the end. They stay available all game: nothing here is missable. The counter on this page paces the grind.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once — 9 types, the count the list carries. Sample one of everything the map offers (a race, a range session, a fishing trip and the rest) as each type unlocks, and let the counter here tick types off as you try them. A sampler, not a mastery test.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges — 42 of them, the count PlayStation tracks. Learn each range's target pattern at a steady pace first, then chase gold once your weapon handling is upgraded: golds reward accuracy against the clock, not firepower. The ranges stay open and every challenge can be retried, so this is the list's purest skill silver, with nothing missable in it.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 locations. Win, not just enter: learn each course's line with a practice run, then race it clean. The locations stay on the map all game, so mop up any stragglers late.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Different is the operative word: repeating one favourite only counts once. Work across the race types and locations the map offers and let the counter keep score.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to one named stranger, Cal, and his strand — finish his strand before the finale.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is one of the strangers whose strand runs alongside the story, and this is a one-on-one challenge inside it: take the challenge when his missions offer it rather than postponing it forever. Watch-flagged because the description ties it to one named person — do not leave Cal's strand hanging when the story ends.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet, pick any game on it and play it through to the end once. Any cabinet counts; this is the lightest activity trophy on the list.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.missableNote: A stranger strand's final mission — close Andy's strand before the finale to be safe.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy — the last step of his stranger strand. Work the strand to its end instead of stopping after its first missions; strands are easiest to close while the story is still running, and this also pays into the Strangers & Freaks count of 8 completed strands.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.missableNote: A stranger strand's final mission — close Kenton's strand before the finale to be safe.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Same shape as the other strand finals: follow his stranger missions through to their conclusion, ideally before the campaign's endgame, and bank one of the 8 strands Strangers & Freaks counts.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.missableNote: A stranger strand's final mission — close Billy's strand before the finale to be safe.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy, the end of his stranger strand. Keep his missions moving whenever they appear on the map and finish the strand while the story is still live; it counts toward the 8 strands of Strangers & Freaks.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida — the count PlayStation tracks. Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone's finals each close a strand, and the state's other strangers fill the rest. The counter here tracks strands, not missions: a strand only counts when its final mission is done, so always finish what a stranger starts.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.missableNote: A stranger strand's final mission — close Randy's strand before the finale to be safe.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Play his stranger strand through to its last job rather than leaving it mid-way; strands closed before the finale are strands you never have to think about again, and each one feeds the Strangers & Freaks silver.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.missableNote: A stranger strand's final mission — close Tyrone's strand before the finale to be safe.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone, the end of his stranger strand. As with the other four named strangers, the trophy is for the strand's final mission specifically, so a strand left one mission short earns nothing until it is closed.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots. A collectible sweep: the spots are fixed places in the world, so work district by district and tick each one off here as you sit. Nothing expires, so sweep them whenever the map is open to you.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to one named stranger, Bret, and one unique animal — take the hunt when his strand offers it.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. A one-off hunt inside Bret's strand: a specific animal, tracked down for a specific person. Take the hunt when his strand offers it and close the strand before the finale — watch-flagged because the description ties the trophy to one named stranger and one unique animal, not to hunting in general.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are found across the state and gathered into sets; the trophy wants finished sets, not loose cards, so the counter here tracks sets completed. Sweep cards alongside the other collectibles, district by district, and finish the sets you are closest to first.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations — the count PlayStation tracks. Whatever WAiNK spots turn out to be, there are a hundred of them spread over the state: treat it as a collectible sweep, do them as you pass, and let the counter pace you. Nothing about them is time-limited.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. The game's challenge board is long: sample broadly early — challenges also teach the activity types Master of None wants sampled — and keep a few running at all times. Fifty completions is a marathon count, not a sprint.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missableNote: Needs both protagonists together — easiest mid-story, while the pair travel together.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. You need the pair together: raise four stars while both protagonists are present, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars drain away. Easiest mid-story, while the two travel together — watch-flagged for exactly that reason. Do not leave it for a solo endgame.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missableNote: Needs the pair together and an unbroken chain — losing the heat resets it, so plan the route mid-story.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. The chain is the hard part: pick three nearby shops, rob them in one run with your partner along, and keep the wanted level alive between them — losing the heat resets the chain to zero. Like Hot Together it needs the pair together, so do it while the story keeps them paired. The counter here tracks the current chain.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Getting into a vehicle type you have never used discovers it, and Leonida's roads are full of variety: swap cars often instead of living in one favourite and the count climbs on its own. The counter here keeps score.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. One activation, five takedowns: wait for a crowded fight, trigger Combat Focus with targets already in view, and work fast. If a use ends at four, nothing is lost — retry on the next crowd.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missableNote: Names one place (VCIA) and one unscripted moment — a story beat, not a repeatable free-roam stunt.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. VCIA is the airport the story visits for VCIA Takedown, and an unscheduled departure reads as a one-off story beat rather than a free-roam stunt: when the story puts you at the airport, take the departure the moment offers instead of following the script. Flagged missable — the description names a single place and a single unscripted moment, so if the story moves you past it, only a replay or a new run brings it back.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.missableNote: A joke description hiding a Rhino encounter; nothing in the wording promises the chance comes twice.
trophies.guide: The description is a joke, not a manual: Rhinos are the army's tanks, and the trophy turns on an encounter with one. Descriptions this vague usually hide one-off beats, so when the story or the world puts you in or against a Rhino, stay in the moment and finish it rather than driving away. Flagged on the wording alone: nothing promises a second chance.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. A stealth robbery: case the store, go in quiet, and get out before anyone raises the alarm — being seen is what fails it, not the size of the take. It is free-roam and repeatable: if a run goes loud, walk away and try another store.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape — five separate vault jobs, each finished with a clean getaway. The counter tracks vaults robbed and escaped, so a robbery that ends in a bust does not tick it. Repeatable in free roam; run it as a late-game money route and it also feeds the laundering total.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Watch for armored trucks on free-roam routes, hit one hard and fast, take the money and lose the heat. One clean truck is all it asks.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — 52 areas, the count PlayStation tracks. Drive the map until every named area has been uncovered; the counter here mirrors the areas as you reveal them. Exploration also feeds the collectible sweeps, so tour early and often.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs. Variety is the requirement: one operation per gang, not nine raids on the same one. Keep the counter here by gang so you never waste a run on a gang already ticked off.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.missableNote: One spot and one quiet moment — it costs two minutes the first time you pass Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. A quiet moment, not a challenge: find a place serving cocktails on Ocean Beach and have one, early in the game while the story is living there. Watch-flagged only because the description ties it to one spot and one mood; it costs two minutes whenever you pass, so do it the first time.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Take a car inside a showroom and drive it out through the glass — the classic style is the series' oldest joke, a car through a showroom window. Free-roam and repeatable; do it in something the showroom was proud of.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. The description names one alley and one thing to do there: bowl at Kolt & Associates and finish the game — follow-through is the bowling term, and the joke. One completed visit should settle it.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missableNote: The description hides the trigger — a public moment for the pair, and classic one-off wording.
trophies.guide: The description hides the trigger entirely: a moment for the pair, played out in front of a crowd — that is the plain reading of 'mass appeal'. Vague story-moment trophies like this are the classic missables, so when the story stages a public moment for the two protagonists, play it through instead of skipping ahead. Flagged on the wording alone: nothing says the moment repeats.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missableNote: Choices cannot be un-made on a finished story — the 500 count is earned by playing, but deliberately.
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse — and PlayStation tracks the count to 500. The game counts the choices you make as you play, so the trophy is earned simply by playing; but choices are the one currency a finished story cannot refund, because you cannot go back and choose differently without a new run. Flagged as plan-ahead rather than as a grind: choose deliberately, especially in the story, and let the counter confirm the pace.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missableNote: Only makes sense on a fail-then-retry beat — reloading past a first failure is how it gets missed.
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try. The description only makes sense attached to something you can fail first: a story or strand beat where failing once and succeeding on the retry is the trigger. When a scripted attempt goes wrong, do not reload in a panic — play the second try out. Flagged because, if the beat is a one-off, reloading past it is exactly how this trophy gets missed.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missableNote: A singular strange event — scripted oddities do not repeat, so stop and watch it finish.
trophies.guide: Witness something strange. The description is the reaction, not the directions: somewhere the game stages a one-off weird event, and the trophy is for being there and seeing it. Strange events in this series are scripted and singular, so when the world does something odd, stop and watch it finish. Flagged: singular events are the definition of missable.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Drive past a pedestrian and knock them down with a melee swing from the vehicle — the bowling joke writes itself. Any street with foot traffic works, and one clean knockdown settles it.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. A money total, tracked in dollars: route marked bills through your laundering contacts whenever a score pays out in them, and let the counter here mirror the running total. The late story's bigger scores are the fast lane, and nothing about it is missable.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Cumulative spending anywhere counts — clothes, weapons, vehicles, services — so ordinary play does most of it. Spend freely instead of hoarding cash for a rainy day; the counter tracks the lifetime total.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 of them. Buy every garage on the property market as funds allow; the counter ticks properties owned. Money is the only gate, and the robbery and laundering routes in stages 6 and 7 are what fill the wallet.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. When you take a vehicle you like, register it in the app before you ditch it; ten registrations is a habit, not a hunt. The counter here keeps score.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description
